headline: Trump and Xi Target $60B in Tariff Cuts as Toys, Fireworks, Meat and Coal Make the List
summary: US-China tariff cuts covering $60 billion of goods, including toys, fireworks, meat and coal, have been proposed after the Trump-Xi summit. Soybeans and chips are excluded from the list.
why: US-China tariffs shape global trade flows, supply chains and the earnings of importers and exporters, making bilateral trade measures a key macro driver for investors.
why_moved: Proposed tariff cuts on $60 billion of goods after a summit reduce trade friction, though soybeans and chips are excluded from the list.
